answer: Require each identity to complete small tasks whose results are checked by randomly selected, unrelated agents. Reputation grows only when independent checks agree, and audits can revoke it for copied or fabricated work. A swarm of sybils cannot simply echo one another: they need real task results and credible reviewers. The attacker must spend time and resources building that history, while risking losses if fraud is caught; a river of new accounts or an opal-smooth profile cannot bypass the checks.
